description: This file defines a Java interface 'Amqp10Config' that provides configuration settings for the MQTT protocol over AMQP 1.0, including timeout durations, throttling, queuing, backoff, and other protocol-specific parameters.

classes.name: Amqp10Config.Amqp10ConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for the 'Amqp10Config' interface.

methods.name: isConsumerRateLimitEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether rate limiting based on throughput and acknowledgements is enabled.

methods.name: getConsumerMaxInFlight
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of unacknowledged messages allowed, including redelivered messages.

methods.name: getConsumerRedeliveryExpectationTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration after which messages requesting redelivery are forgotten.

methods.name: getConsumerThrottlingConfig
methods.description: Returns the consumer throttling configuration object.

methods.name: getConsumerThrottlingInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration interval for consumer throttling, defaulting to the value from 'ThrottlingConfig'.

methods.name: getConsumerThrottlingLimit
methods.description: Returns the throttling limit for consumer messages per interval.

methods.name: getProducerCacheSize
methods.description: Returns how many message producers to cache.

methods.name: getBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the backoff configuration used for internal actors.

methods.name: getMaxQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of messages buffered at the publisher actor.

methods.name: getPublisherParallelism
methods.description: Returns the number of parallel message publications per publisher actor.

methods.name: getGlobalConnectTimeout
methods.description: Returns the connect timeout for the AMQP 1.0 client.

methods.name: getGlobalSendTimeout
methods.description: Returns the send timeout for the AMQP 1.0 client.

methods.name: getGlobalRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the request timeout for the AMQP 1.0 client.

methods.name: getGlobalPrefetchPolicyAllCount
methods.description: Returns the input buffer size for AMQP 1.0 consumers.
